definitions.gloss: non-prescription glasses; fashion glasses; fake glasses
definitions.explanation: Glasses worn purely for fashion or appearance rather than to correct vision. The lenses have no corrective power.

examples.japanese: {伊達眼鏡|だてめがね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{眼鏡|めがね}→眼鏡：00651_megane⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{伊達眼鏡|だてめがね}で、⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{入|はい}っていない→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: Those glasses are just for fashion — they have no prescription.

examples.japanese: ⟦{知的|ちてき}→知的：13700_chiteki⟧な⟦{印象|いんしょう}→印象：01846_inshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えたくて→与える：01821_ataeru⟧、{伊達眼鏡|だてめがね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: Wanting to give an intellectual impression, I wore fashion glasses to the interview.

notes:
Composed of {伊達|だて} (showing off, for appearance) + ⟦{眼鏡|めがね}→眼鏡：00651_megane⟧ (glasses). The word {伊達|だて} here means 'for show' or 'for style,' from the same root as the expression {伊達|だて}⟦じゃない→じゃない：28483_janai⟧ ('not just for show'). Sometimes written in kana as だてめがね or だて⟦{眼鏡|めがね}→眼鏡：00651_megane⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {伊達眼鏡|だてめがね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ — to wear fashion glasses
- {伊達眼鏡|だてめがね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧はずす — to take off fashion glasses
- {度|ど}なし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{眼鏡|めがね}→眼鏡：00651_megane⟧ — non-prescription glasses (alternative expression)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Fashion glasses are a popular accessory in Japan, commonly worn to create a more intellectual or stylish look. They are sold at variety shops and fashion stores alongside regular accessories.
